seasonalNotes: Long rains (March-May) cover the main maize and bean crop in most of Central and Western Kenya.
Short rains (October-December) are the secondary planting window; outcomes more variable.
Coffee leaf rust pressure rises with humidity in the warm-and-wet shoulder seasons.
farmerFriendlyGuidance: Plant certified maize seed and scout for fall armyworm starting at the V3 leaf stage.
Stake tomatoes early and prune lower leaves to reduce early- and late-blight pressure.
Inspect coffee leaves monthly for rust pustules during the long rains.
